mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_log (USER_ID, USER_IP_ADDR, CNTN_MENU_NM, JOB_SE_CD, TRGT_KEY_VL, LOG_CN, CHG_BFR_CN, CHG_AFTR_CN, JOB_RSLT_CD) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userIpAddr}, #{cntnMenuNm}, #{jobSeCd}, #{trgtKeyVal}, #{logCn}, #{chgBfrCn}, #{chgAftrCn}, #{jobRsltCd})
mapper.select: SELECT J.*, U.USER_NM, (SELECT MAX(C.CNTN_BGNG_DT) FROM cntn_log C WHERE C.USER_ID = J.USER_ID AND C.CNTN_YN = 'Y' AND C.CNTN_BGNG_DT <= J.LOG_CRT_DT) AS LGN_DT FROM job_log J LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = J.USER_ID WHERE J.JOB_LOG_SN = #{_parameter}
